purpose: Present focused short content or confirmation through a native modal dialog.
accessibility: The native dialog has an accessible title and description.
Focus moves into the dialog, Escape dismisses it, and focus returns to the opener.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: description
api.description: Supporting context announced with the primary content.

api.name: onClose
api.description: Callback fired when the surface requests dismissal.
